register.labelZh: WORK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: work around 可以表示想辦法避開問題;work out 可以表示找出答案;work through 則可以表示逐步處理事情。；work at 可以表示努力改善;work away 可以表示持續埋頭工作;work up to 則可以表示逐步邁向較難的目標。；你可以用 work on somebody 表示設法說服某人,用 work somebody out 表示看懂某人,也可以用 work yourself up 表示憂慮或怒氣愈來愈強。；裝置可以 work off a battery,表示由電池供電;運動則可以幫助你 work off 多餘精力、大餐後的熱量或怒氣。
register.summaryEn: Work around can describe finding another way past a problem. Work out can describe finding an answer, while work through can describe dealing with something step by step. Work at describes trying to improve. Work away shows continued effort, and work up to shows progress towards a harder goal. You can work on somebody to persuade them, work somebody out to understand them, or work yourself up when worry or anger grows. A device can work off a battery, while exercise can help you work off extra energy, a heavy meal or anger.
